policy.identity: The 35 GeoNames records are retained because the named SIRUTA seat/locality identity is established.
policy.sourcePreservation: Do not overwrite reports/places/candidate-reviews.json expected latitude/longitude; those fields pin the reviewed GeoNames snapshot.
policy.coordinateUse: These points are correction candidates for a later coordinate-override/normalization stage and are not yet runtime-applied.
policy.provenance: SIRUTA is used for identity and parent linkage. The correction point is a mapped physical settlement point and is explicitly not represented as an official INS centroid.
